content:
sam: quick note from onboarding: reproducible parity glitch where req-id gets redacted in logs but still present in headers, then lost on retry. happens when TELEMETRY_OTEL=1 and LOG_AUTOINIT=1.
toni: can you paste the minimal repro or logs? is this different from previous hook-order races?
sam: here's an extracted sequence:
IN: headers={"x-req-id":"req-9x"}
LOG: info handling request request_id="[REDACTED]"
RETRY: outgoing headers={} status=200
so header arrives, logger shows redacted value, retry drops header.
eli: that suggests two issues: (1) redactor running against logger-bound context, (2) retry not copying original headers. which SDKs?
sam: node sdk@2.4.x in quickstart, python sdk@1.11.x in sampleapp. toggling LOG_AUTOINIT=0 fixes the logger masking but we still need the retry-preserve fix.
toni: short-term: implement retry shim to copy X-Req-Id from original attempt if missing. add unit tests for 401->retry that assert header preserved.
eli: long-term: change scrubber so it only scrubs external payload keys and not logger/span context. add REDWOOD_REDACT_WHITELIST defaulting to ["x-req-id", "request-id"] and document it.
qa-bot: ci: created job repro/reqid-scrub-order (node+python) queued.
sam: i'll open a PR with: small dockerized repro, retry shim, unit tests (node+python), and docs note about init order. will include migration steps for customers relying on current behavior.
toni: add a note to SDK init docs recommending telemetry register before autoinit logging and an env flag REDWOOD_INIT_ORDER to force telemetry-first for backward-incompatible cases.
eli: also call out python import-time logging tricky case in PR; include a small advisory in release notes.
sam: thanks, will ping thread when PR is up. :thumbsup:
